$description: DataTable (platform/components/DataTable): the tokens of its footer, which the modes "pages" (the range, the rows-per-page choice and Pagination) and "load-more" (the count and Load more) add under the grid (owner, 2026-10-14). The grid's own tokens are in the shared set.

data-table-footer-border-color.$description: DataTable footer: the line above it (a row's line).

data-table-footer-text.$description: DataTable footer: its text (the range or the count, the rows-per-page label), as Pagination's.

data-table-footer-gap.$description: DataTable footer: the space between its parts (Pagination's gap).

data-table-footer-row-gap.$description: DataTable footer: the space between its lines when the parts wrap in a narrow grid.

data-table-footer-padding-block.$description: DataTable footer: the space above and below its controls.

data-table-footer-padding-inline.$description: DataTable footer: the space at its start and end.

data-table-footer-label-gap.$description: DataTable footer: the space between the rows-per-page label and its Select (Pagination's per-page gap).

data-table-fit-max-height.$description: DataTable (fill, load-more): the body is at most one screen tall until the grid has measured the room left under where it starts (then that room, written on the body).
